text: From the ADR 0024 review (4e689be37), for S4: story/consistency.scala:84-120 flags narrated-world duplication of speech content only as an advisory Warning. It needs a text witness, the same predicate and participants, and overlapping textSpans, and it is suppressed by a ReferenceEdge in referencesOut, not by a cited premise. A promotion from media-anchored (ASR) speech has no textSpans and never trips it. S4 must use the reference-edge mechanism and close the media gap. The ADR's wording ("must cite its twin as a premise ... must keep tripping that check") is imprecise here.
